product: ulixacaltamide for essential tremor, which has no FDA-approved ET-specific therapy and affects over 7M Americans, peak-sales floor about 10B dollars (2026-04-14 IR; 2026-08-06 call). relutrigine for SCN2A/SCN8A DEE, about 10,000 US patients. elsunersen for early SCN2A. No product is marketed yet.
demand: Pre-revenue: FY2026 revenue about 0.88M dollars (stockanalysis). Future growth is volume from new launches of ulixacaltamide and relutrigine, not price or mix; management discussed ulixacaltamide pricing around 50k-100k dollars per year (2026-08-06 call). No commercial price/mix exists yet.
pricing_power: Commercial build and burn: Q2 2026 operating expenses 96.9M dollars and 78M dollars operating cash use, with G&A rising for two field forces (about 300 reps) and inventory (2026-08-06 call). Also pricing or reimbursement pushback on ulixacaltamide above 50k-100k dollars per year, or any CRL or further delay.
competition: For essential tremor, cheap generic propranolol and primidone are already available substitutes. For SCN2A/SCN8A DEE there is no approved low-cost substitute. No Chinese or other low-cost equivalent for these assets was found.
market_strategy: CEO Marcio Souza, 2026-08-06 call: this would be the year Praxis become a commercial company, with two NDAs in late-stage review and both approvals expected in about six months; We will be ready ahead of PDUFA to launch ulixacaltamide for ET patients; 1.4B dollars cash funds runway into 2028.
bull: Two NDAs in late review with fixed PDUFAs (relutrigine 2026-12-27, ulixacaltamide 2027-01-29), clean BIMO with no Form 483, no advisory committee, $1.4B cash into 2028, and dated raises from Goldman, RBC, Wells Fargo, Raymond James.
bear: Pre-revenue with no marketed product; relutrigine PDUFA already slipped from 2026-09-27 to 2026-12-27; Q2 opex $96.9M and $78M cash burn; cheap generic propranolol/primidone compete; 21-day momentum -25.6%.
falsifier: A Complete Response Letter or a second PDUFA extension for relutrigine on or before 2026-12-27.
web_what_changed_30_90d: 90d: FDA extended relutrigine PDUFA to 2026-12-27 from 2026-09-27 as a major amendment with no safety or manufacturing concerns (2026-06-29 SEC 8-K); Breakthrough Therapy Designation for elsunersen (2026-06-22 8-K); Q2 2026 results, 1.4B dollars cash (2026-08-06 IR); Remagine Labs deal (2026-07-07). 30d: analyst reiterations (2026-09-24), inducement grants (2026-09-03), shares slid (2026-09-23).
web_true_now_not_modelled: Per 2026-08-06 call: the FDA BIMO inspection of Praxis closed with no findings and no Form 483 for both NDAs; mid-cycle reviews indicated no advisory committee for ulixacaltamide or relutrigine; EMERALD over-enrolled at about 200 patients. Fixed PDUFAs: relutrigine 2026-12-27, ulixacaltamide 2027-01-29.
web_demand_product: ulixacaltamide for essential tremor, which has no FDA-approved ET-specific therapy and affects over 7M Americans, peak-sales floor about 10B dollars (2026-04-14 IR; 2026-08-06 call). relutrigine for SCN2A/SCN8A DEE, about 10,000 US patients. elsunersen for early SCN2A. No product is marketed yet.
web_price_volume_mix: Pre-revenue: FY2026 revenue about 0.88M dollars (stockanalysis). Future growth is volume from new launches of ulixacaltamide and relutrigine, not price or mix; management discussed ulixacaltamide pricing around 50k-100k dollars per year (2026-08-06 call). No commercial price/mix exists yet.
web_bottleneck: The company's own bottleneck is having no marketed product: two NDAs sit on binary FDA PDUFAs (relutrigine 2026-12-27; ulixacaltamide 2027-01-29) plus a launch build-out. It relieves the bottleneck of no targeted therapy for essential tremor and SCN2A/SCN8A DEE.
web_who_benefits_next: Second-order: contract manufacturers plus the new distribution network and hub pharmacy partners (inventory build, 2026-08-06 call); Remagine Labs, the transdermal ulixacaltamide partner (2026-07-07 IR); genetic testing and diagnostics for DEE; specialist neurologists and epilepsy centers.
web_who_loses: Incumbents: generic propranolol, primidone and beta-blockers in essential tremor, and existing sodium-channel-blocker anti-seizure drugs and DEE anticonvulsants, if ulixacaltamide and relutrigine win. Competing DEE programs with weaker efficacy also lose share.
web_margin_collapse_risk: Commercial build and burn: Q2 2026 operating expenses 96.9M dollars and 78M dollars operating cash use, with G&A rising for two field forces (about 300 reps) and inventory (2026-08-06 call). Also pricing or reimbursement pushback on ulixacaltamide above 50k-100k dollars per year, or any CRL or further delay.
web_low_cost_substitute: For essential tremor, cheap generic propranolol and primidone are already available substitutes. For SCN2A/SCN8A DEE there is no approved low-cost substitute. No Chinese or other low-cost equivalent for these assets was found.
web_ceo_promised: CEO Marcio Souza, 2026-08-06 call: this would be the year Praxis become a commercial company, with two NDAs in late-stage review and both approvals expected in about six months; We will be ready ahead of PDUFA to launch ulixacaltamide for ET patients; 1.4B dollars cash funds runway into 2028.
web_did_they_deliver: Partly. The promised 2026-09-27 relutrigine action date was missed, extended to 2026-12-27 (2026-06-29 8-K). Delivered: FDA accepted both NDAs (2026-03-30; 2026-04-14), elsunersen BTD (2026-06-22), and a clean BIMO inspection with no Form 483 (2026-08-06 call).
web_what_would_falsify: A Complete Response Letter or a second PDUFA extension for relutrigine on or before 2026-12-27, or a CRL or delay for ulixacaltamide by 2027-01-29; a negative EMERALD readout; POWER2 or POWER3 failing again; or cash runway falling short of 2028.
